Game Overview

Europe at War puts players into a strategy experience centered on quick, browser-based gameplay.

How to Play

Playing Europe at War comes down to a simple loop. Jump in, follow the on-screen goal, and aim to beat your own best result each run.

Related FAQs

What is Europe at War?

Europe at War is a free strategy game you can play instantly in your browser, with no download required.

Is Europe at War free to play?

Yes, Europe at War is completely free to play in your browser on GameBurst — no download or installation needed.
